title: Named-root authority recovery holds StateInner ~700 ms at engram_root_authority.rs:967, blocking boot and outstanding-work reads
outcome:
Greg reported this on the central Windows host after the 15:10Z restart (master 86c882dc), relayed by Engram::Advisor #2192. Repeated long StateInner holds at src/engram_root_authority.rs:967:36: 687 ms and 700 ms, each with acquisition wait 0. That line is `recover_engram_authority_batch_until`'s locked read: naming history, namer, reader target, the abandoned-journal scan with `engram_root_reporter_available` per journal, and unresolved runs.

Paths blocked behind it:
- claude_outstanding_work.rs:785:40, waited 615 ms;
- app_boot.rs:683:25, waited 700 ms;
- claude_outstanding_work.rs:684:36, waited 496 ms.

Same window: named-root reclamation for store github.com/grlap/TermAl, work 01a17c3d-07c9-7612-8c94-c346c6671b82 (w-c346), generation 2002, reported persistence unconfirmed (Deadline), writer tick 89 ms, authority image unknown/state busy; pass attempted=2, limit=8, elapsed 2051 ms.

Goal: the recovery batch's locked section is bounded (target: hold p99 under 50 ms, consistent with the trim-slice bound) by moving per-journal work off the lock or making it proportional to the batch, without changing recovery semantics or authority decisions.
acceptance: On the named source root, the existing active-batch and empty-batch recovery_lock::root_recovery_ regressions pass, running 100 samples per case with the unchanged 50 ms bound. For active (sessions,journals)=(64,1),(1024,1),(4096,1),(4096,256) and empty (4096,256), empirical p99 of each call's longest foreground StateInner hold is below 50 ms; with 100 ordered samples this is the logged second_worst_us value, which must be below 50000, independently of the tests' median assertion. Each active case performs exactly 100 canonical reads; the empty case performs none.

Recovery preserves the existing authorized-reader eligibility and namer-first stable selection, exact original store/run association, eight-read batch limit, current owner/reader/selection/journal/route revalidation and canonical proof/settlement rules. The scaling tests retain exact pending journals and owner identity, clear only the completed unresolved run, and existing recovery/reader parity regressions pass; no focus adoption, new authority owner, persistence change or deadline/timeout increase is introduced.
The maintained standard full launcher gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
